question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 I 组：塞内加尔 vs 伊拉克（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group I: Senegal vs Iraq (90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: 非洲杯冠军塞内加尔满员出战、Elo 高出 253 分，对小组最弱的伊拉克占据明显优势，但末轮出线形势未知带来轮换变数。
one_liner_en: AFCON champions Senegal, at full strength and 253 Elo points ahead, hold a clear edge over the group's weakest side Iraq, though unknown matchday-3 stakes add rotation risk.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差 253 分（塞内加尔 1860 vs 伊拉克 1607），Davidson 模型给出约 64% 的基准胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 253-point Elo gap (Senegal 1860 vs Iraq 1607) yields a ~64% baseline win probability in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 塞内加尔以非洲杯冠军身份满员出战：马内领衔，帕普·萨尔与哈比卜·迪亚拉伤愈复出。
key_reasons.en: Senegal arrive as AFCON champions at full strength: Mane headlines the squad, with Pape Sarr and Habib Diarra back from injury.

key_reasons.cn: 伊拉克阵容深度有限：26 人名单多效力国内联赛，旅欧主力仅伊克巴尔、哈马迪等少数人。
key_reasons.en: Iraq's depth is limited: the 26-man squad is mostly domestic-based, with only a few Europe-based regulars such as Zidane Iqbal and Ali Al-Hamadi.

method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) p_stat 63.6/21.5/14.8; bounded evidence adjustment (+1.4pp Senegal, +0.5pp draw, -1.9pp Iraq; cap +/-8pp) -> p_final 65/22/13. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 and +/-25 Elo sensitivity.
